rows.notes: Shared historical/news request helper is utils/helpers.py:4 get_data (plain GET + JSON decode + detail->auth error); it is identical for all rows here - what differs per row is only URL construction and request multiplicity. This row: base_url branches /tiingo/daily vs /iex by interval (:144-148), one request per comma-split symbol via asyncio.gather (:199-200), interval remapped to resampleFreq (1m->1min, h->1hour, :165-170), symbol column derived onto rows only for multi-symbol (:193-196), date cast differs daily-vs-intraday with tz_convert America/New_York (:228-233). No paging.

No dedicated upstream ETF model exists: provider registers EtfHistorical -> TiingoEquityHistoricalFetcher (__init__.py:19, no etf_historical.py in models/). Relative to the EquityHistorical row and the shared get_data helper (utils/helpers.py:4), nothing differs on the request surface - same daily-vs-iex branch, same per-symbol fan-out, same returned fields, same paging (none); only the model identity and query param names differ. Capability set copied from the actual fetcher code in equity_historical.py:144-200.

Single path /tiingo/news (:100). Differs from the shared get_data helper usage in equity rows: it builds a whole URL list up front - limit>1000 becomes ceil(limit/1000) precomputed offset pages (offset=page*1000, :110-113), gathered in parallel (:127) and concat-extended, with no next-page cursor. Ticker filter is server-side via symbol->tickers alias (:25). crawl_date parsed via dateutil (:65-69); tags/tickers list->comma-string validators (:59-63).

Same /tiingo/news path and same precomputed offset-page fan-out over the shared get_data helper (utils/helpers.py:4) as CompanyNews. What actually differs from the CompanyNews row: no tickers symbol filter at all (world-wide list, only optional source-domain filter, :28), data-side renames add site<-source (:46), and transform slices results[:limit or len] (:142-145). Returned fields otherwise identical contract.

Differs from equity/currency rows on the shared get_data path in three real ways: ONE request for all symbols (tickers comma query param, :126 alias), path /tiingo/crypto/prices (:125), and response is an array of ticker objects each with nested priceData rows that must be exploded (:165-181). interval->resampleFreq remap adds a day arm (7d->7day, :128-135); results sorted client-side by date (:183); no paging. C92 upstream read: start_date/end_date default from datetime.now().date() (crypto_historical.py:103-108); one request, no paging, sorted date ascending with no cap (:183). | C96: relative_date_default is off this row's blocker list -- crypto_historical.py:103-108 fills both bounds from datetime.now().date() and the start bound is now - relativedelta(years=1) (:105), so the carrier is RelativeDefault(years=-1) beside an all-zero RelativeDefault for the end bound (:108) -- NOT the days=-90 offset an earlier draft of this note claimed; the line was re-read and the 90-day figure is refuted. Nothing is wired: opendata/data/providers/tiingo/ does not exist, so there is no spec module to carry the declaration, and the row's other needs (the :165-181 nested priceData explode and the :128-135 resampleFreq remap) are carried by facets the engine already ships. The row therefore lands in the census shipped_cover set, not in expressible_today: what is left is a package, not a capability.

C94 line re-audit kept the fan-out (symbols = query.symbol.split(',') at :120, one get_one(symbol) task each, gathered at :153, results extended into one list at :151; single base URL :100 so no interval branch unlike equity) and replaced param_value_mapping, which had folded onto the PRESENT param.value_mapping: interval is never sent verbatim -- it is excluded from the query string at :106 and rewritten by suffix surgery into a DIFFERENTLY NAMED parameter at :109-116, then interpolated at :124. A value table cannot rename a key, so the mechanism is param.value_transform. New second blocker: the output column set depends on how many symbols the caller passed -- ticker is popped and re-added uppercased only when len(symbols) > 1 (:142-144), so the schema is request-cardinality-dependent and the contract's symbol column arrives either way (:58 alias). date is cast on two arms by the interval suffix (:146-149 daily .date() vs intraday utc), rows sorted client-side by date (:174-177), no paging. Per-symbol failures are swallowed into a messages list and warned alongside partial results (:130-138, :161-163); the token travels in the query string (:99, :124); and the first get_querystring (:101-103) is dead, overwritten immediately at :105.

Single symbol embedded in the path /tiingo/corporate-actions/{symbol}/distribution-yield (:52) - the shared get_data helper is called with no querystring building at all. Returned fields are one flat date+yield record set with trailingDiv1Y rename (:24); limit applied client-side as a tail slice data[-limit:] (:63), no server paging loop.
